metadata_findings: The only MetadataAssociation is SCIENCE ASSOCIATED to the record itself (OMIAuraAER 1): a self-relation, which should be removed or replaced with the lineage below.
The DATA SET LANDING PAGE (https://www.earthdata.nasa.gov/data/catalog/ges-disc-haqes-na-pm25-bc-county-1) is the landing page of an unrelated dataset.
No ATBD in RelatedUrls; the only document is the shared MEaSUREs README.
No PublicationReferences, and the README does not name the OMI L1B collection or channel; 388 nm implies OML1BRVG.
The README (2018) predates the record's end date (2023-05-04) and does not mention why production stopped.

excluded.detail: Named generically; IMS has no CMR collection.
354 nm lies in both the UV-2 (307–383 nm) and VIS (349–504 nm) channels; the README does not say which is used.
The gridded products were made from L2 version 1.1, not 2.
Operational gridded analogues; no data dependency.

excluded.candidate: CALIOP and GOCART layer-height climatologies, TOMS/OMI surface-albedo climatology, AIRS CO climatology
